note: Bighorn NF campground in lodgepole and spruce on West Tensleep Creek, 3 mi up FS Road 27 from US-16 (about 21 mi NE of Ten Sleep), near the West Tensleep Lake trailhead into the Cloud Peak Wilderness. Run by a concessionaire. --Claude
summary: FS page + recreation.gov 250042: 9 non-electric sites (one first-come, site 02), $18.50 2026-2028 ($9 second vehicle), hand-pump water, vault toilets, 14-day limit, rig limits 30-75 ft per site (site 10 pull-through), sold Jun 11-Sep 5 2027; FS says Memorial Day-Labor Day and the site is gated for winter now. West Tensleep Creek is ~10-15 m wide (creek); sites 07 and 06 sit ~20-30 m from it over open meadow -> recommend riverview -> creekside.
flags: WATERFRONT (recommend riverview -> creekside): West Tensleep Creek is ~10-15 m wide at the campground, so river values don't apply - the stored 'riverview' should be creekside or not waterfront on the creek scale. On zoom-19 imagery site 07 (44.205322,-107.235777; RV parked on it) is ~20-30 m from the creek's north bank across open grass meadow with a few scattered conifers; site 06 (44.205196,-107.236303) ~25 m, partly through a few trees; site 08 (44.205724,-107.235389) ~16-20 m from the bend through grass and shrubs at the edge of a tree clump. recreation.gov tags 06 and 07 'Riverfront'. All three are reservable by the night. The stored evidence ('forest-edge treeline screens pads') does not match the zoom-19 view at 06/07: the treeline is behind the pads, not between them and the creek.
